text:
viv: thinking through a minimal "justification flow" for autofallback samples. goal: let ops triage without exposing PII and make any de-redaction explicitly audited. quick thoughts?

priya: sounds good. sketch the flow?

dan: proposal: three levels of view: masked (default), justify-view (operator requests de-redact with short justification -> requires second approver for enterprise), and audit-only (full payload only in encrypted audit store). each de-redact creates an immutable audit record.

viv: UI microcopy: when someone clicks "Request view" open a small modal: Reason (required), TTL (default 1 hour), Approver (auto-assign on-call). show the audit text that will be recorded.

priya: sampling controls too: per-rollout `sample_rate`, `burst_cap_per_min`, and `priority_boosts` for classifier reasons. show estimated storage and monthly cost next to toggles.

dan: runtime note: we should avoid hot DB writes. use a lightweight write path: sample metadata to main table, full payload to encrypted object store only when retention=enterprise or when de-redact approved.

viv: API sketch to include in docs:
```
POST /rollouts/{id}/samples/config
{
  "sample_rate": 0.005,
  "burst_cap_per_min": 10,
  "reasons": ["latency","model_error"],
  "de_redact_policy": "two_person_enterprise",
  "retention_days": 7
}
```

priya: RBAC: `samples.view_masked`, `samples.request_view`, `samples.approve_view`, `samples.export`. approve_view requires different role or 2nd approver if tenant is enterprise.

infra-bot: note: enabling sampling on route "/replies" with 0.5% -> estimated storage 4.2GB/month compressed. schema migration scheduled on toggle.

dan: bulk actions: cluster + bulk dismiss / bulk pin-to-issue / bulk-apply-suggestion. clustering window default 6h. also add a "suppress route" if a route is noisy to avoid operator overload.

viv: audit considerations: every interaction writes: operator id, action, justification, timestamp, decision_trace_id. surface audit feed in the rollout history.

priya: one small UX safety: show estimated operator load (actions/hr) and warn if sample rate would exceed recommended capacity.

dan: I'll prototype the runtime shim for sampling + two-step de-redact flow. viv will mock modal copy. priya will draft RBAC matrix. target: demo in next sprint.

viv: ack. starting mocks today. :thumbsup:
